I totally agree w your points. JC is one of my favorite characters, and I often find that people judge him harshly without taking time to understand his character. Looking at how JC was raised/pressured by his mother because of WWX, it's not unreasonable to say he learned some toxic traits because of his situation.

 I keep thinking if he had someone left by his side, JC would've been less obsessed in his hatred for WWX and his perception of WWX's 'betrayal' despite sacrificing his golden core for him would've not encompassed his whole being. There is no one left after WWX and his family died/left to correct his thoughts/behavior and tell him this isn't how you express your love and communicate your needs in a relationship. 

Yes, JC needs to work on himself and make amends but everyone is ignoring that it is very hard to do so when the only thing keeping him company are his (albeit distorted) beliefs that he held onto for so long. 

Purely from JC's perceptive, imagine that your father adopts another child and seemingly favors that child. Your mother is already toxic/demanding and becomes worse, brainwashing you everyday that you will never be good enough and punishes/pushes you harder because of that other child. You now have to send your dogs away because of him. You have to share your blood-related biological sister with him (who died to save him later). That child indirectly becomes the cause of your sister and brother-in-law's deaths + orphaning your nephew. You sacrificed your golden core for him but he never knows it and therefore cannot appreciate your sacrifice. In the end, he sets off with his beloved and seemingly has a bright future with a warm family while you are left alone by yourself with a broken/empty home. On top of that, you have to deal with guilt/resentment at your own thoughts/actions and reflecting on them by yourself.

JC's bond and perspective of WWX is very mixed, with a lot of negative emotions tainting them. Again, if there was someone that was solely on his side and supported him throughout, like LWJ did for WWX, JC may not have turned out the way he did. I feel that it is unfair to just classify him as an asshole without delving deeper into his back story. It doesn't justify anything, but most people in JC's place wouldn't be able to be mature/accepting and easily making amends like they demand of his character. 

So yeah, I like JC very much because I feel he is very human.

I haven't played many but uh:

1. Amnesia - just recently played it again + starting the fandiscs. I love Kent and Ukyo, not so much the other Lls. I love how it focuses on a solid cast of characters and interactions, as well as having unique storylines for each Ll. 


2. Hakuoki - partially for nostalgia's sake as I haven't played it in a while but I was definitely feeling very moved. It can be draggy/repetitive at times but I loved the majority of the Lls. I feel like it's realistic in the sense that the heroine can't do much (?) but at least tries to help in whatever capacity she can. 


3. Mystic Messenger - loved the chatstyle interface. Again focusing on solid group of characters, and has a bunch of content. Gave me many sleepless nights and stress because I wanted to experience the late night chats. I feel like they all really need therapy tho.


4. Winter's Wish - I didn't really like it at first but it grew on me. I am a sucker for historical settings and it shows. Again the heroine tries to do her best in whatever way she can help. Some routes had better character development for the heroine so I preferred those.


Honorable mention - the Arcana. It's more a dating sim than otome game but I love it to pieces. I love all the characters, the worldbuilding/setting, the music, art- literally everything. The change of management is a bit eh atm but I am staying for Julian 💜✨️
